answer_1.quote: We propose Entity Knowledge Propagation (EKP), a new task where we want to update model parameters to reflect an emerging entity that is unseen in the LMs' pre-training corpus.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates text spans to fill in cloze tasks based on updated knowledge about emerging entities.

answer_2.quote: Following prior work in the knowledge updating literature, we will evaluate two criteria: update success and specificity. Each of these criteria is evaluated with respect to a base metric, which is either perplexity or accuracy, depending on our dataset.
